title: Surgery Benefits Takayasu Arteritis With Stenosis in the Descending Aorta
off: Surgery Improves Survival Rate in Patients With Takayasu Arteritis: a Retrospective Observational Study
summary: The long-term prognosis and optimal management for Takayasu arteritis(TA) patients with severe stenosis of the descending thoracic and abdominal aorta remain undefined. We want to compare the clinical outcomes of surgical intervention and medical management.

i: Procedure: open surgery or interventional treatment

primary.tf: Patients underwent follow-up from discharge until study termination (3 years to 11 years) or death, whichever came first
